card.name: Start of worsening or exacerbation words
card.fires_on: The first piece of "Worsening", "Exacerbations" or "aggravate" when the word is split, often after "New Onset or" in warning section headings.

modes.label: Worsening after New Onset or
modes.description: The capital W that begins "Worsening" in section headings like "New Onset or Worsening Renal Impairment".
modes.example: 5.4 New Onset or<< W>>orsening Renal Impairment When

modes.label: Aggravate or exacerbate
modes.description: The opening piece of "aggravate" or "exacerbations" before the rest of the word.
modes.example: 5.1 Severe Acute<< Ex>>acerbations of Hepatitis B Severe

card.writes: It pushes the model toward completing words like "exacerbate" and "aggravate" and away from other word endings.
card.plain: It marks the start of words meaning getting worse, like worsening, exacerbation or aggravate.
